description: Hiking trail between Mud Lake Recreation Site and Parbury Falls
directions:
From Hwy 5 north of Blue River, take Mud Lake-Redsands FSR (past River Safari Tours). Proceed 3 km then take small road to right, follow this 1 km into recreation site. Trail (user maintained) starts at east end of site.
4WD recommended, very rough access.
title: Parbury Falls Trail
